title: That Label's Got Style: Handling Label Style Bias for Uncertain Image Segmentation
note: Variant: probabilistic (c-Prob.U-Net style) head with source as the style variable, run only if src_film passes. The one-hot source code itself is src_film, so only the stochastic part is new. Evidence is 179 blob images, weak for 1 px cracks.

title: The Treasure Beneath Multiple Annotations: An Uncertainty-Aware Edge Detector (UAED)
note: Not covered: no arm uses the 2021 and 2022 label versions as two annotators with a learned per-pixel mean and variance. ridge_snap moves labels by image evidence and src_film only conditions on source. Label version moved crack IoU by 0.05 to 0.08 (BRIEF 5, Labels row), so a second annotator view is the largest known lever. Code exists (ZhouCX117/UAED). Also covers P293 and the variance map for the benchmark.

title: Training Like a Medical Resident: Context-Prior Learning Toward Universal Medical Image Segmentation (Hermes)
note: No code found. Joint training with UCF-EL needs the class mapping that the P371 benchmark track builds first; UCF-EL pretrain-then-finetune was n.d. or worse (BRIEF 5) and joint training is untested, but a re-implementation costs more than the named alternatives (P184, P372).

title: Probabilistic Modeling of Inter- and Intra-observer Variability in Medical Image Segmentation (Pionono)
note: Per-source latent Gaussian is the same idea as src_cm and src_film (per-source style), and src_cm is itself parked as not identifiable with one label per cell. No code. Weaker evidence than named arms.

title: MEMO: Human-like Crisp Edge Detection Using Masked Edge Prediction
note: Not covered: refinement networks on frozen house logits were never tried (BRIEF 5 never-tried list) and no T4 arm changes the decoding stage; ridge_snap acts on labels, not on predictions. Progressive reveal could link fragments (76 to 88% of components under 20 px) and gives crisp lines. Code exists (cplusx/MEMO_Edge_Detection), 1.2% extra parameters, trains on top of existing W1a logits.

title: Transformer-Based Annotation Bias-Aware Medical Image Segmentation (TAB)
note: One query per source tests the same per-source preference as src_film at higher build cost; repo targets PyTorch 1.7 so re-implementation needed. Open only if src_film passes and a per-source head is wanted.

title: Diversified and Personalized Multi-Rater Medical Image Segmentation (D-Persona)
note: Label versions as raters is the same question as the promoted P184 (UAED), which is lighter (single stage). Run D-Persona only if P184 shows the two label versions carry usable signal. Code exists.

title: U-Harmony: Enhancing Joint Training for Segmentation Models with Universal Harmonization
note: No code. Source-gated decoder for unknown source is partly measured by the src_film unk row; E1 is all CSIR so the gate has little to choose. Reopen if src_film unk loses against own.

title: Segmentation Style Discovery: Application to Skin Lesion Images (StyleSeg)
note: Discovers within-source styles; within-source variation is the jitter that src_calib and D0 (WAVE2_REVIEW X5) measure on existing dumps first. Needs the src_calib per-source table showing a bimodal within-source width before any training. Code exists.

title: Pixel Difference Networks for Efficient Edge Detection (PiDiNet)
note: Architecture change (pixel difference convs in ResNet-34 stages) tests local contrast, which the T5 input arms (crackcue_input, thin_geometry_aux) already address from the input side. Code exists, cheap, but ranks behind P372 and P240 for this family; revisit after T5 results.

title: Resolving Inconsistent Semantics in Multi-Dataset Image Segmentation
note: Baseline for the cross-dataset track: map UCF-EL, MultiSolSegment, PVEL-S classes onto the 24 classes. Joint training is open in BRIEF 5 but no code was found, so it stays a benchmark track.

title: SAUGE: Taming SAM for Uncertainty-Aligned Multi-Granularity Edge Detection
note: Not covered: BRIEF 5 Foundation encoders row closed only frozen linear probes and one DINOv3 ConvNeXt fine-tune; SAM or SAM2 adapters, multi-layer fusion and decoders are listed as open. Targets E1 half-cut and scuff generalisation, which no T4 arm touches. Code exists (Star-xing/SAUGE), 1.5% adapter parameters.

title: EasyControlEdge: A Foundation-Model Fine-Tuning For Edge Detection
note: Needs the gated FLUX.1-dev download (user OK required), no code found, and the 8x latent may erase 1 px cracks. Higher cost and weaker evidence than P372 for the same foundation-model direction.

title: Multi-style conversion for semantic segmentation of lesions in fundus images by adversarial attacks
note: Variant of src_calib: test-time adversarial push toward a source's style, no training. Run only if src_calib passes (per-source convention learnable); compare against the cross-fitted per-source bias, not argmax. No code found.

title: DiffusionEdge: Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Crisp Edge Detection
note: Generative thin-structure baseline for the method suite. First gate is autoencoder reconstruction of 1 px GT crack maps (cheap CPU/GPU check). Code exists.

title: Label Noise in Segmentation Networks: Mitigation Must Deal with Bias
note: Evidence paper, not an arm. Its biased versus unbiased split matches the per-source offset and width table src_calib already produces; cite it in the benchmark report of label-bias sensitivity.

title: Stochastic Segmentation Networks: Modelling Spatially Correlated Aleatoric Uncertainty
note: Low-rank Gaussian head has the same identifiability limit as src_cm (one label per cell) and its main product is uncertainty for severity flags, which is not wanted unless severity adds value. No code found.

title: Practical Edge Detection via Robust Collaborative Learning (PEdger)
note: Label denoising from collaborating models is tested by oof_selective_ignore with leak-free N0 teachers (WAVE2_REVIEW X6). Mean Teacher at 100% with the pool was n.d. (BRIEF 5 row 1) but that is not the same mechanism, so not VOID. No code found.

title: Generative Edge Detection with Stable Diffusion (GED)
note: Same VAE-latent risk for 1 px cracks as DiffusionEdge, whose reconstruction check comes first; no code found. Revisit only if that check passes.

title: A Probabilistic U-Net for Segmentation of Ambiguous Images
note: Reference multi-rater baseline for the benchmark method suite and base of D-Persona. Not run for score.

title: Evaluating medical AI systems in dermatology under uncertain ground truth
note: Benchmark scoring design: report metrics with a ground-truth uncertainty interval using the two label versions and the 2 px band. CPU only.

title: Tiny and Efficient Model for the Edge Detection Generalization (TEED)
note: 58K-parameter efficiency-axis member of the method suite. Code exists.
